package.description: Desktop app to rule your space

en-US.description: Desktop app to rule your space
en-US.longDescription: Ajax Desktop transforms an end user’s desktops into full-fledged security control centers. Manage security modes for specific groups or the entire facility, monitor each device’s state, and view live streams from multiple system cameras — all within a single, intuitive interface. With informative real-time notifications, no alarm or on-site event goes unnoticed.
en-US.name: Ajax Desktop

zh-CN.description: 帮你掌控个人空间的桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription: Ajax Desktop 可将终端用户的桌面设备转变为功能完备的安全管控中心。用户既能为特定群组或整个场所配置安全模式、监控每台设备的运行状态，也可查看多路系统摄像头的实时画面，所有操作都可在一个直观便捷的统一界面内完成。系统会推送信息丰富的实时通知，确保不会遗漏任何警报或现场事件。
